notes: Catálogo operativo del MVP. Se priorizan acciones observables y pocos clics. Los agregados se derivan posteriormente; no se registran manualmente.

qualifiers.name: key_pass
qualifiers.definition: Pass directly followed by a teammate shot before possession changes.

qualifiers.name: assist
qualifiers.definition: Final pass directly leading to a goal. assist=true implies PASS SUCCESS and key_pass=true.

qualifiers.name: second_yellow
qualifiers.definition: UI shortcut for a dismissal by second yellow; the stored event is CARD RED with second_yellow=true.

qualifiers.name: set_piece_result
qualifiers.definition: Observable end of the dead-ball sequence. Used only when a corner/free-kick restart occurs; avoids subjective CHANCE labels.

qualifiers.name: penalty_taker_player_id
qualifiers.definition: Optional own-team taker. If known, the UI may create a linked SHOT event for the taker; the PENALTY event itself does not alter shot totals.

capture_rules.rule: FOUL events capture x/y so dangerous-foul status can be derived later from a validated spatial rule instead of a subjective manual button.
CORNER FOR/AGAINST and FOUL RECEIVED/COMMITTED define attacking/defending set-piece context automatically.
Every corner/foul keeps video_second/match_second so set-piece clips can be extracted later.

derived_rules.rule: PASS with outcome FAIL implies possession_lost=1 and loss_reason=FAILED_PASS
DRIBBLE with outcome FAIL implies possession_lost=1 and loss_reason=FAILED_DRIBBLE
PASS LONG or CROSS counts automatically toward total passes
PASS key_pass=true counts toward key_passes; assist=true counts toward assists and also implies key_pass=true
Every SHOT outcome counts automatically toward total shots
Every TACKLE counts toward tackles_total; TACKLE SUCCESS counts toward tackles_won
CARD RED with second_yellow=true represents a dismissal by second yellow and preserves both disciplinary consequences in derived counts.
PENALTY WON/CONCEDED stores the penalty context/result; it does not itself create player shot/goal totals. A linked SHOT is created only when the own-team taker is known.
dangerous_foul is not a raw click. It will be derived from captured foul x/y after the spatial threshold is validated in the Feature Engine.
